Operator decision: NOT A DEFECT — approved ENHANCEMENT delivered via the normal plan-review path.

The compact-summary output of the complexity gate's `--check` (`active=<A> new=<N> increased=<I> stale=<S>`) is the documented, --help-surfaced, unit-tested contract per ADR 0058 (module "Exit-code contract" docstring command 3; tests/unit/test_complexity_baseline.py::test_run_check_allows_stale pins exact output; test_help_documents_contracts pins the summary tokens in --help). No spec, test, or invariant requires per-symbol detail on a failing check, so nothing is currently violated — there is no RED oracle. Surfacing per-symbol new/increased detail ADDS a new user-visible output capability to a documented public-contract gate, which is a feature-request, not a defect. Closing not_a_bug (no caused_by attribution applies); the enhancement is tracked as a discovered_from task and taken through author→plan-review→claim→implement.
